The '''Wistril system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Fath sector/Legends|Fath sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wistril]].

==History==
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] stopped the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] in the Wistril system to take on supplies, and inadvertently took on [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] as well, who [[Rescue on the Chimaera|rescued]] [[Talon Karrde]] from their clutches.
